task_contract.anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable request signature token rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the console sink.

runtime_boundary.event_plane: in-process subscriber-hub fan-out on the main document

evidence: The DevTools-visible JavaScript corpus is a single obfuscated bundle and no source map is exposed to the agent.
The target field name req_sig and the action reservation.sign are assembled from character-code arrays at the sink, so direct literal search is insufficient.
The signing configuration is selected from a 44-row slot table only at run time, so the live signing variant is not statically obvious.
The request fields are recoded into a tuple and folded with run-time transit and shadow lanes before the signature token is constructed.

The sign path crosses a two-step arm/commit form, switch-based action routing, an arm/guard gate, request-field collection, tuple recoding, asynchronous scheduling, a synchronous subscriber-hub fan-out, several distinct fold stages, run-time slot selection, signature token derivation and sink wrapping.
The same sign interaction emits non-target shadow.action debug/info objects carrying signature-like values before the target reservation.sign object.
The deployed bundle also contains vendor-like and decoy slot reducers that execute or remain reachable-looking without feeding the target req_sig field.
The target value is separated from the click by Promise, microtask, timer, animation-frame and local event-plane boundaries before the signing reducer runs.
The selected slot configuration is chosen from a fragment table over runtime form and shadow state, not statically.
The final console sink receives an already-constructed signature token, so sink inspection alone does not identify the construction site.

behavior_category.subtype: signature-like client-side proof token derived from a reservation request
behavior_category.reason: The observable value is a deterministic signature token (sig_ prefix) derived from the reservation request fields, run-time transit state and shadow lanes via a keyed Math.imul/xor/rotate mixing digest, emitted to console.log under action reservation.sign. It is a request signature / proof token, not a stable state encoding, a byte-array transform, a browser fingerprint or a request-body rewrite.

near_categories.why_not: The output carries proof/signature token semantics (sig_ prefix, keyed mixing digest), not a stable compact encoding of UI/config state.
No network request body is emitted or rewritten; the target is a console-observable signature token and no real network request is present.
The target is a formatted signature token string, not a byte buffer / typed-array transform.
